caption: The drawing consists of six rectangular sections arranged in two columns and three rows on a beige background. Each section contains a different decorative pattern in shades of brown, red, pink, cream, and black. The top left section features horizontal bands with alternating designs of zigzags and abstract organic shapes in cream, brown, pink, and red. The top right section displays a brown background with cream-colored floral motifs, including daisy-like flowers and leaves, arranged along diagonal stems. The middle left section has a brown and cream background divided diagonally with white dotted lines and cream floral outlines, including detailed blossoms and leaves. The middle right section shows two horizontal pink bands with wavy black lines and enclosed cream shapes, separated by a beige and black striped band. The bottom left section consists of a repeating pattern of cream and brown circular flowers with black surrounds, set against a pink background with white dots. The bottom right section contains large, cream circular shapes surrounded by jagged red and black rings on a black background, forming a repeating motif.
title: Materials from Quilt
